properties.description:
Caliber Outbound is a productized cold outbound service for B2B 
companies with $10,000+ ACV. We run the infrastructure, copy, 
targeting, and reply triage so founders take qualified meetings 
on their calendar.

WHAT WE DO
We register and warm dedicated sending domains, build signal-based 
prospect lists, write operator-led copy with AI-assisted personalization, 
and triage every reply within four business hours. You take the calls. 
We handle everything that gets you to them.

HOW WE WORK
One operator. Eight clients max. No junior SDR handoffs. The person 
you book the call with is the person running your account every week. 
This is intentional. Outbound at the quality we deliver cannot be 
scaled past eight engagements by one person, and we will not pretend 
otherwise.

THE GUARANTEE
Day 1 to 60: If fewer than 7 qualified meetings hit your calendar, 
the following month is credited 50%, applied automatically. Month 3 
onward: rolling 60-day minimum of 16 qualified meetings, with the 
same 50% credit mechanism if missed. Two consecutive missed windows, 
mutual exit, no penalty. Your infrastructure stays yours.

WHO THIS WORKS FOR
B2B SaaS, agencies, consulting, fractional services, and B2B services 
with $10,000+ annual contract value and a closer ready to take meetings 
inside five business days of booking. We will tell you on the strategy 
call if outbound is wrong for your motion before either of us spends 
another minute.

OPERATED BY
Efe Ozcanli. Background in business development, marketplace operations, 
and demand generation across B2B and high-velocity e-commerce.

HEADQUARTERED
Reno, Nevada. A subsidiary of Karimer LLC.

LEARN MORE
caliberoutbound.com

results.title: Kyley Cheever
highlights:
I help you attract more clients and close more deals | Founder at Honeyleads and KC Inc. Consulting
...
I was a 20 year old college intern when I sent my first cold email. I didn’t really know what a “cold email” or a “cold call” was. I remember viewing it all in very simple and straight forward terms. My boss was a talented photographer who wanted to shoot movie posters and TV posters. I remember saying to him "Well, why don’t I just reach out to them for you?” “Them” being the likes of marketing heads at CBS Studios, Warner Bros., Disney, and FOX. I quickly learned that when you send cold emails…you get ignored. When you make cold calls…gatekeepers were not going to hand you off to their boss. That you go into it all, super excited about what you have to say and offer…and nobody really cares. So why, 16 years later, am I running an agency that does this for other businesses? Because I learned this other part… With a good product, and a lot of persistence…it actually eventually works 🙂 I worked with the photographer for 3 years. After hearing many “no thanks,” we’re all set ""not enough industry experience,” we eventually got one “yes.” And I was able to snowball that one yes into many more. Until I was able to use strategies I learned to: Age 23: Close deals with Marketing Execs at Disney, Warner Bros. FOX, CBS, and Comedy Central... with zero (and i mean ZERO) industry experience or connections. Age 24: (and still a complete nobody) Send cold emails to Tina Fey, Steve Martin, Robin Williams and 150 other top comedians…and convince them to participate in this book I got hired to produce. Age 25: Start a farm-to-table lunch box delivery company out of my tiny NYC apartment and grew it into an almost $1.5M/year luxury catering company. Now with my lead gen agency Honeyleads, - I've generated over 25 thousand leads. - And helped close over $15M in sales. Do I know everything? Nope. (Still growing daily, that's for sure.) But I do know some things that work and some that don't. And I want to help fellow small to medium business owners: - Take control of their sales strategy. - run a more effective business. Interested? Follow along!
...
